records.title: DQN experience replay
records.statement: Experience replay stores transitions and samples randomized minibatches to reduce sequential correlation.

records.title: DQN target network
records.statement: A separately parameterized target network is held fixed between periodic updates to stabilize Q-learning targets.

records.title: DQN Atari evaluation
records.statement: DQN was evaluated on 49 Atari 2600 games using pixels and game score as input signals.

records.title: Retrieval augmented generation
records.statement: Retrieval-augmented generation conditions generation on externally retrieved evidence.

records.title: RAG citation grounding
records.statement: Citation-grounded RAG should bind factual claims to retrieved source passages.

records.title: RAG retrieval evaluation
records.statement: Recall at k measures whether expected evidence appears within the top k retrieved items.

records.title: Python aware datetime
records.statement: An aware datetime object has enough timezone information to locate itself relative to other aware datetime objects.

records.title: Python naive datetime
records.statement: A naive datetime object does not contain sufficient timezone information to unambiguously locate itself.

records.title: FastAPI UploadFile
records.statement: FastAPI UploadFile exposes a spooled file interface suitable for uploaded files without loading all bytes into memory.

records.title: React useEffect
records.statement: React useEffect synchronizes a component with an external system after rendering.

records.title: TypeScript generics
records.statement: TypeScript generics preserve type relationships by parameterizing reusable components over types.

records.title: SQLite write-ahead logging
records.statement: In WAL mode SQLite appends changes to a write-ahead log before checkpointing them into the database file.

records.title: Git rebase
records.statement: Git rebase reapplies commits onto a new base and rewrites the identities of the reapplied commits.

records.title: Git merge
records.statement: Git merge joins development histories and may create a merge commit while preserving existing commit identities.

records.title: Windows AppContainer
records.statement: Windows AppContainer provides a capability-based process isolation boundary with restricted access to system resources.

records.title: Windows Filtering Platform
records.statement: Windows Filtering Platform provides filtering hooks used to inspect and control network traffic.

records.title: LSP definition request
records.statement: Language Server Protocol definition requests resolve a symbol occurrence to its declaration location.

records.title: LSP references request
records.statement: Language Server Protocol reference requests enumerate locations that refer to a symbol.

records.title: Tree-sitter incremental parsing
records.statement: Tree-sitter builds concrete syntax trees and supports incremental updates after source edits.

records.title: Repository impact analysis
records.statement: Change impact analysis follows dependency and reference edges from modified symbols to downstream consumers and tests.

records.title: DOCX comments
records.statement: DOCX comments are stored in a comments part and linked from document ranges by comment identifiers.

records.title: DOCX tracked revisions
records.statement: Tracked insertions and deletions in WordprocessingML are represented with revision elements and author or date metadata.

records.title: XLSX formula recalculation
records.statement: Spreadsheet formula text and cached calculated values are distinct, so a calculation engine may be required to refresh cached results.

records.title: Knowledge provenance
records.statement: Knowledge provenance records the source and locator that support a stored claim.

records.title: Knowledge conflict governance
records.statement: Conflicting claims should remain reviewable and should not silently overwrite trusted active knowledge.

records.title: Knowledge expiration
records.statement: Expired or superseded knowledge should be excluded from default retrieval while retaining its version history.

records.title: Task knowledge context pack
records.statement: A task context pack should contain only relevant claims, citations and confidence within an explicit token budget.

records.title: Stable knowledge search policy
records.statement: Stable knowledge that can be answered from sufficient local evidence should not trigger web search.

records.title: Fresh knowledge search policy
records.statement: Freshness-sensitive facts require current external evidence before answering.

records.title: Community evidence search policy
records.statement: Open-ended experience questions benefit from community sources while factual claims retain authoritative support.

records.title: Isolated coding workspace
records.statement: Coding changes should execute in a task-specific workspace so the user's source worktree remains unchanged.

records.title: Coding failure classification
records.statement: Coding failures should distinguish environment, test, implementation and requirements-understanding failures.

non_conflicts.title: DQN convolutional encoder
non_conflicts.statement: DQN uses convolutional layers to encode image observations.

non_conflicts.title: RAG indexing
non_conflicts.statement: RAG systems may index documents before retrieval.

non_conflicts.title: Git branch naming
non_conflicts.statement: Teams may define conventions for Git branch names.

non_conflicts.title: DOCX styles
non_conflicts.statement: DOCX style definitions are stored separately from document text.

non_conflicts.title: LSP diagnostics
non_conflicts.statement: Language servers can publish structured diagnostics for source files.
